description: Imports and Exports Control Department - Further Amended Extra Gazette No. 2312/77 on 01.01.2023, Imports and Exports (Control) Regulation No. 08 of 2024
categorisation: This gazette content promulgates new regulations under the Imports and Exports Control Act, specifically the "Imports and Exports (Control) Regulations No. 08 of 2024." It involves legal/regulatory matters including amendments to existing regulations, import licensing procedures, and operational instructions to authorities. While it mentions Minister Ranil Wickremesinghe, it does not focus on his appointment or portfolio responsibilities but rather on the regulatory framework being established, making it primarily a legal/regulatory matter.
